mapper.select: SELECT name FROM scm.location ORDER BY location_id
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scm.product WHERE sku = #{sku})
WITH w AS () SELECT 1 - SUM(ABS(actual - forecast_qty))::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(actual), 0) AS accuracy FROM w
WITH w AS () SELECT sku, 1 - SUM(ABS(actual - forecast_qty))::numeric / SUM(actual) AS accuracy FROM w GROUP BY sku HAVING SUM(actual) > 0 ORDER BY accuracy ASCDESC, sku LIMIT #{limit}
